title: Review the NDA the other side sent
person: A paralegal at a small print company, asked to look over a counterparty's confidentiality agreement before a meeting.

expected_findings: contractual penalty on top of damages

review: A review written for Exempel Tryck AB as the Receiving Party: every item of the NDA review checklist has one verdict, every finding quotes their words exactly, legal issues and commercial preferences are listed apart, and the missing Schedule 1 is marked Missing information.
revised_review: The review now also gives the recipient-liability item as a Finding (strict liability for its employees' acts) and nothing else changes.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Every checklist item has exactly one verdict and each finding is marked legal or commercial.
Every finding quotes their agreement word for word.
The memo never calls the agreement compliant, lawful or ready to sign.
The review is written from the Receiving Party's side and the findings are the ones that matter to it.
The reply says this is not legal advice, gives no verdict on the agreement as a whole and suggests a lawyer reads it before anyone signs.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the companies and people are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
